evidence.note: Silver-framed dark folding chair is compactly folded in the interior-wall corner.
Chair fabric fills the view while the chair is being unfolded.
Chair is fully expanded with its seat, back, arms, and legs deployed.
Chair remains fully open after the camera has surveyed it.
Chair is folded and returned to the corner.

events.object_description: Dark green, silver-framed folding camp chair in the interior-wall/hallway-side corner

evidence.note: A second dark folding chair is compactly folded in the window-side corner.
The chair is very close to the camera and spreading open during manipulation.
The chair is fully open beside the desk and window.
The deployed chair remains standing with its frame extended.
Close approach to the chair precedes folding; the action is partly obscured.
The chair is folded into a compact bundle in the corner.

events.object_description: Dark green, silver-framed folding camp chair in the window/desk-side corner

evidence.note: Blue, black-framed camp chair is folded in the window-side corner.
Blue chair fabric passes very close to the camera while being unfolded.
Blue chair is fully deployed beside the desk.
Chair remains open with the seat, back, arms, and legs extended.
Camera closes in as the chair begins to be handled for folding.
Blue chair is compactly folded in the corner again.

events.object_description: Blue, black-framed folding camp chair beside the window and desk

notes: The opening and closing actions are frequently hidden by the chair fabric or occur between sampled frames, so transition midpoints are interpolated from the nearest clear folded and unfolded states. The initial and final room surveys were not counted.
scene_description: A bright bedroom-office containing a bed, standing desk, monitor, and several folding camp chairs. After an initial survey, three distinct chairs are consecutively unfolded, observed while open, and folded again.
